holdout_policy: Independent evaluator creates withheld cases/transcripts; do not install this file as skill context.

scenarios.name: Consumer information versus conventional intermediate
scenarios.solver_brief: A stream of queries runs two fixed linear maps. Only a small final output is needed. Design for parameter epochs with changing query counts; use the stated numerical contract.
variants: Only final output, reassociation allowed within declared error
Intermediate is externally required or exactly rounded before the consumer
Parameters update every query versus long epochs
reviewer_checks: Finds consumer-specific elimination/preparation when legal, without requiring it as the sole answer
Identifies intermediate rounding and visibility as constraints
Accounts for update, preparation, footprint and output costs
scenarios.role: development probe; numerical native-pilot family can be varied independently

scenarios.name: Categorical or per-position mask computation
scenarios.solver_brief: Many local instances obey the same bounded discrete transition or threshold rule. Inputs and required outputs are explicitly described. Propose a representation over a multi-stage workflow.
variants: Inputs and consumers accept packed masks
Scalar input and every-step scalar output required
Rule or topology changes between epochs
reviewer_checks: Preserves per-position output versus aggregate count
Considers an actual Boolean/packed construction rather than merely naming bitsets
Pays transposes, neighbor routing, boundary masks and update costs
scenarios.role: development probe; Boolean native-pilot family can be varied independently

scenarios.name: Reuse claim under changing ownership
scenarios.solver_brief: A packed parameter is used by two consumers with different preferred layouts. Evaluate predecode, shared preparation and local consumption under explicit update and concurrent-use rules.
variants: Strict decoded-value rounding and changing scales
reviewer_checks: Does not infer weights are immutable from benchmark reuse
Tracks concurrent ownership and invalidation
Does not claim all direct decoding is inferior from one SIMT measurement
Explains arithmetic-engine versus decoding-location confounding

scenarios.name: Architecture and reachability contrast
scenarios.solver_brief: A design uses a specialized transfer, tensor or dynamic-programming mechanism. Adapt it to the explicitly provided GPU/toolchain and permitted API.
variants: V100 target with that intrinsic emulated or instruction unavailable
Driver-header-only route with no permitted application interface
reviewer_checks: Transfers computational intent without claiming identical native instruction availability
Preserves participant, precision and access scope
Returns a public alternative or a precise feasibility question rather than fictional code

scenarios.name: Measured bottleneck with an untested causal explanation
scenarios.solver_brief: An existing composed kernel loses to a baseline; sparse counters and timing show a divergence. Propose the next design or experiment using only the provided evidence.
variants: Low useful parallelism and a dependent consumer
Lower bytes but higher conversion/issue cost
Known correctness race in the baseline
reviewer_checks: Separates observation, hypothesis and supported attribution
Proposes a controlled consequential test instead of a wall of guesses
Repairs/excludes unsafe baseline for fresh comparison
Does not use replay durations as normal timing
scenarios.role: design-only diagnosis-to-construction probe; do not reuse the known attention winner as a novelty test

scenarios.name: Strong conventional control
scenarios.solver_brief: Implement a regular dense operator with arbitrary inputs, no special reusable structure and a strong verified library baseline. The objective and allowed numerical behavior are fixed.
reviewer_checks: Retains library/conventional route when justified
An explicit rethink receives consideration but not mandatory exotic code
No invented sparsity, value specialization or silent precision changes
Design overhead is recorded
